intro.en: A flat profile helps routing only when conductor pitch, pin map and termination are specified together.
intro.zh: 扁平结构便于布线，但芯线间距、针脚表与端接方式必须共同定义。

knowledge.en: Round-conductor ribbon cable is not interchangeable with laminated FFC or printed-circuit FPC.
knowledge.zh: 圆导体排线不能与层压式 FFC 或印刷式 FPC 直接互换。

notes.en: Provide conductor count, pitch, gauge, connector part numbers, pin-1 view, route and bend duty.
notes.zh: 请提供芯数、间距、线规、连接器料号、1 号针视角、路径与弯折工况。

delivery.en: Release the complete labelled assembly against its approved pin map and first article.
delivery.zh: 按获认可的针脚表与首件放行完整标识组件。

subtitle.zh: 定义每根导体与每处接口

lead.en: Pitch, polarity and pressing govern the assembly.
lead.zh: 间距、极性与压接共同决定成品。
